acceptanceCriteria: The HLQ failure for a missing repository-data envelope includes the additionalContext text it received, so a visible fallback degradation is distinguishable from a malformed envelope.
The cause of the intermittent upgrade-case failure is identified and either fixed or recorded with its host-load bound in the HLQ spec.
Three consecutive claude-code HLQ runs at load averages above 80 each pass or name their cause in the report.
body: On 2026-09-27 the HLQ-V1 claude-code tuple (Claude Code 2.1.267, adapter 0.2.3, darwin/arm64) on Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 154 (fc594fa6) passed 8 of 9 cases. Case upgrade failed with "SessionStart: additionalContext carries no repository-data envelope" at load averages 81-109 on 12 CPUs. A rerun of the same tuple and binary, with a harness copy that prints the received text, passed 9 of 9 at load 97-125, so the failing text was not captured. An earlier run at 54e0c517 showed "Corvint FALLBACK degraded: adapter-host-kill-deadline" on PostToolUse (cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:118), which suggests SessionStart hit the adapter host-kill deadline under load and emitted the visible fallback instead of an envelope. conformance/host-lifecycle-v1/main.go:947 reports the failure without the text it received.
title: HLQ claude-code upgrade case intermittently gets no repository-data envelope from SessionStart under host load
